notes.claim: A best-fit line mimics the trend and may miss most plotted points; the idea is a line with equal numbers of points either side.
A force against extension graph is a straight line through the origin only while the limit of proportionality is not exceeded.
One student read the y intercept of a best-fit line as the work done against friction.
Carried backwards, copper's resistance-temperature line meets the temperature axis at -234.5 °C, a prediction beyond the readings (SECONDARY: lecture text).
A lamp filament's resistance rises with temperature, so its V-I graph is not a straight line (i6).
A least squares fit of a linear function to experimental data is the calculated alternative to a line laid by eye (i6).
Regression lines are taught at college, in Pearson's HN Analytical Methods for Engineers unit (i6).
